boundary_statement: 本报告是基于传统命理与占星象意的反思性文本，不是实证性人格测量、医疗或心理诊断，也不应代替重大生活决策。

sections.content: 【表达与创造】行星、星座与宫位的组合可作为观察表达方式的象征性线索。传统十神关系可用于观察表达、支持与约束之间的互动方式。本节置信度：探索性。
sections.limitation: 宫制与出生时间不确定性可能改变解读语境。；需结合完整命局理解，不用于判定实际行为。；传统象意仅作为反思线索，不是实证性诊断。

limitations: House system and birth-time uncertainty can change the context.
This interpretation is not an empirical or clinical assessment.
signal_provenance.traditional_rule_ref: Modern Western astrology, planet-in-sign synthesis; Stephen Arroyo, Astrology, Psychology, and the Four Elements

limitations: Requires the complete chart context and does not determine behavior.
Traditional correspondence is not empirical personality assessment.
signal_provenance.traditional_rule_ref: Zi Ping Fa (子平法), Ten-God relationship method; Yuan Hai Zi Ping (《渊海子平》)

sections.title: 表达与创造

sections.content: 【关系与边界】地支关系可作为观察情境中亲和、拉扯与边界的象征性线索。本节置信度：探索性。
sections.limitation: 局部关系必须放回整体命局，不构成因果预测。；传统象意仅作为反思线索，不是实证性诊断。

limitations: Relation facts must be interpreted with the full chart.
No empirical causal or diagnostic status is claimed.

sections.limitation: 解读受容许度与整体星盘影响，不用于诊断或预测。；传统象意仅作为反思线索，不是实证性诊断。

limitations: Aspect interpretation depends on selected orbs and the wider chart.
